description.value: Stem Japanese Eatery is a kappo-style Japanese restaurant in Burnaby where chef-owner Tatsuya Katagiri brings Tokyo training and Vancouver fine-dining experience to a seasonally driven menu emphasising the 'cut and cook' proximity between diner and chef. Dishes are crafted from locally sourced and imported Japanese ingredients, and the restaurant offers an omakase kaiseki experience alongside à la carte small plates. Takeout is also available via email order, making it a convenient stop for cyclists seeking a quality Japanese meal.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (1 space) at 10m; stands (3 spaces) at 46m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at stemjapanese.ca fully confirms the OSM address, phone number, and email. Takeout is prominently advertised via a dedicated menu and email ordering system. The dinner menu explicitly labels items as 'Gluten Free' and 'Vegan,' confirming dietary options; no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag appears to differ from the schedule shown on the website; the OSM record may need updating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service Japanese restaurant with confirmed contact details and takeout service; a viable food stop for touring cyclists in the Burnaby area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dinner menu explicitly labels 'Gluten Free' items (BC Potato Salad, Chawan Mushi with miso option) and 'Vegan' (Daikon Beer Pickles); multiple vegetable-based obanzai small plates also listed

wow_evidence: chef-owner Tatsuya Katagiri brings Tokyo training and Vancouver fine-dining experience

price.label: Fine dining
price.signal: Named chef with wine credentials, omakase service, extensive wine program with sommelier
